institution.name: University of Arkansas Community College at Batesville

plan.notes: Source: UACCB 2026-2027 College Catalog, Health Professions section, Associate of Applied Science Registered Nursing. Genuine term-by-term 'Suggested Course Sequence' (13+11+16+15+15 = 70). GENUINE CATALOG DOUBLE-COUNT kept as printed: the sequence lists 'Psychology' (no number) in the first pre-nursing term and 'General Psychology PSYC 11003' in the first nursing term, so the sequenced sum is 70 vs the stated credential total 67 -- not merged. The pre-nursing entry's title is normalized to the official course name 'General Psychology (PSYC 11003)' per Program Pre and Corequisites; both entries documented as the same course double-listed by the catalog. The sequence rows for the first two terms print course names without course numbers; codes are mapped from the same program page's Program Prerequisites list (documented mapping). GENUINE CATALOG CONTRADICTION kept verbatim: the Program Prerequisites line prints 'Anatomy and Physiology II with Lab (BIOL 10253/BIOL 10151)', reusing the Essentials of Anatomy and Physiology codes (the catalog's standard Anatomy and Physiology II codes are BIOL 24103/BIOL 24101 per the Technical Certificate Health Professions requirements table). The sequence prints a non-course row 'Fall or Spring: Submit Application for Registered Nursing Program' before the nursing terms -- it has no courses or credit and is documented here, not sequenced. General Psychology (PSYC 11003) is a pre/corequisite: Licensed Practical Nurse to Registered Nurse tracks must complete it as a prerequisite prior to entry; the Traditional Registered Nurse track may complete it prior to entry or within the first term.
